verdict.rationale: Extend documents a dedicated Webhook Configuration page covering dashboard setup, global event subscriptions, workflow-specific subscriptions and configuring webhooks via the API. Webhooks are also referenced in the async-processing guidance for production workloads, and test API keys are kept isolated from production webhooks. Missing for 10: an enumerated event catalog with payload details, signature verification and retry/delivery-semantics documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
